review_rule: Function-name routing is never approval. A contract can be approved only after every exact handler row is inspected, row_count and rows_sha256 are frozen, and a failure-path test proves the stated propagation, telemetry, isolation, or cleanup behavior.

action_data_committed_before_optional_ui.evidence: The eight exact Painter Action handlers run only after sticker, 3D blockout scene, or reference-board data is committed. Each optional spawn, visibility, layer, panel, canvas, or dialog refresh failure is returned as a structured operation/type/message row with ui_refresh.committed=true and ui_refresh.ok=false; committed data is not rolled back. The broad-catch scanner explicitly includes editor_adapter_paint.py so adding telemetry cannot hide these catches from the ledger. tests/test_painter_actions.py::test_committed_paint_action_data_exposes_optional_ui_refresh_failures injects all eight failures, proves the sticker/scene/reference data remains committed, and verifies exact diagnostics in the Action payload. UI refresh completion after a failed callback is not claimed.

best_effort_gl_resource_cleanup_before_e.evidence: All Painter OpenGL teardown calls now pass one named operation to _best_effort_gl_cleanup. The helper records a bounded last operation, typed error, cumulative failure count, and whether an active render exception was preserved; it also adds a note to that primary exception without replacing it. Blockout texture/renderbuffer/FBO/default-bind/context/surface teardown, canvas FBO/session/context teardown, context-create/activation failure cleanup, retained compositor temporary textures/FBOs, retained tile FBOs, and retained uploader texture/context/surface close all use this path. State handles are invalidated before destroy calls. Qt documents that doneCurrent clears the thread's current context and that QOffscreenSurface destruction occurs on the GUI thread; Khronos documents the GL deletion entry points; Python documents exception notes. tests/test_painter_3d_blockout.py::test_gl_cleanup_failure_is_typed_and_preserves_primary_error, ::test_retained_compositors_release_resources_when_rendering_fails, ::test_retained_uploader_close_continues_after_texture_destroy_failure, ::test_canvas_session_close_destroys_surface_after_done_current_failure, and ::test_context_create_failure_preserves_product_error_when_surface_destroy_fails inject helper, readback, missing-handle, texture-destroy, doneCurrent, and double-failure setup paths. They prove primary-error preservation, all later cleanup calls, invalidated handles, and exact telemetry. Driver reclamation after context loss is not claimed.

best_effort_gpu_resource_cleanup_after_f.evidence: The three exact cleanup handlers centralize per-handle deletion, fallback-owner close, and normal runtime close. Tile/layer state or CPU ownership is committed before cleanup, handles are removed or invalidated, gpu_owner is cleared before close, and cleanup failures retain type/message in tile or runtime GPU telemetry. tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_gpu_cleanup_failures_are_typed_after_handles_are_invalidated and ::test_null_gpu_compositor_result_falls_back_and_close_failure_is_typed inject deleter, fallback-close, and normal-close failures and prove zero active tile handles, CPU fallback true, GPU active false, and exact diagnostics. Resource reclamation after a driver failure is not guaranteed.

best_effort_parent_or_resource_cleanup_w.evidence: The seven exact handlers cover invalid parent geometry lookup, previous large-canvas runtime close, replacement GPU uploader creation, previous PBR window close, PBR window setup, cutout generation, and cutout temporary cleanup. Each failure retains type and full message in Painter operational_errors or large-canvas telemetry. Cleanup errors use separate keys from the primary open/generation error, so they cannot replace it. A failed cutout adds both its source and partial destination to cleanup targets, returns before sticker commit, and reports any unlink failure separately. tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_parent_and_resource_cleanup_failures_preserve_primary_state injects invalid parent, runtime close, uploader/window lifecycle, PBR source, cutout segmentation, and simultaneous temporary-unlink failure; it proves the first failure remains visible, replacement state is usable where declared, and no sticker is committed. OS resource reclamation after an external driver or filesystem failure is not claimed.

declared_optional_opencv_to_pillow_raste.evidence: The two exact material-mask handlers attempt OpenCV antialiased polyline/line rasterization and then execute a real Pillow L-mode line/ellipse fallback over the same points, width, and weighted value. The backend, fallback count, and typed last reason are exposed through material_raster_backend_status and Painter Action state. tests/test_painter_material_paint.py::test_polyline_and_weighted_segment_have_deterministic_pillow_fallback removes cv2 and proves stable shape and float32 dtype, deterministic non-identity coverage, bounded weighted maximum, identical nonzero support, and explicit Pillow telemetry. Pixel identity with OpenCV and external paint-engine parity are not claimed.

clipboard_failure_recorded_in_operationa.evidence: The six exact PaintDialog clipboard handlers cover paint/image availability reads, paint payload write/read, image retrieval, and durable clipboard-image asset directory creation. Injected OSError/FileExistsError tests prove exception type and full message enter painter_action_state operational_errors, no success result is returned, and normal read/write/asset calls clear only their matching error. Unsupported paint payload and QImage encoder false returns are also explicit error strings. The contract does not claim OS clipboard availability or cross-application interoperability.

decode_failure_reported_in_preflight_err.evidence: The two exact flat-image and layered-PSD decoder handlers preserve the local exception type and full message in integrity.errors and structured integrity.decode_error, set decode_complete and valid false, and prevent import success. tests/test_painter_file_exchange.py::test_flat_image_decoder_failure_is_reported_as_invalid and ::test_psd_decoder_failure_is_reported_and_import_remains_blocked inject exact OSError messages and prove invalid/import-blocked outcomes. This contract does not claim recovery of malformed files or external-application interoperability.

diffusion_failure_exposed_by_diffusion_a.evidence: The exact wet-canvas diffusion handler catches the optional OpenCV stage only after the base stroke raster exists, keeps diffusion_applied false, and returns diffusion_error with the originating exception type and full message. tests/test_painter_wet_canvas.py::test_wet_canvas_diffusion_failure_is_typed_and_never_claimed injects a GaussianBlur RuntimeError and proves the returned report cannot claim diffusion success. This contract does not claim physical wet-media behavior or OpenCV/Pillow pixel parity.

gpu_failure_recorded_in_telemetry_before.evidence: The three exact retained-canvas handlers cover upload, retained-tile display, and normal-layer composition failures. Each records the originating exception type/message, disables the uploader, synchronizes all caches to CPU state, and returns a maintained QImage reconstruction/source-over result with an explicit fallback reason. tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_retained_gpu_uploader_reuses_handle_and_falls_back_on_failure and ::test_gpu_compositor_failures_are_typed_before_qimage_fallback inject all three failures and prove CPU fallback, inactive GPU state, typed telemetry, and non-null/equal QImage output as applicable. GPU/CPU performance or shader pixel parity is not claimed.

gpu_failure_recorded_in_canvas_status_be.evidence: The three exact canvas handlers cover stroke-atlas failure, fallback-renderer import failure, and retained-uploader creation failure. The stroke path records the primary exception type/message, selects active=qpainter and the literal fallback renderer even when the OpenGL module import itself fails, clears cached GPU images, and returns false so the caller paints through QPainter. Retained-uploader construction failure creates a CPU runtime with typed gpu.creation_error. tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_canvas_gpu_failures_select_qpainter_and_expose_reason and ::test_large_canvas_gpu_creation_failure_is_exposed inject both boundaries and prove active CPU state and exact diagnostics. This does not certify later context stability.

invalid_embedded_dab_falls_through_to_du.evidence_required: Distinguish malformed embedded bytes from an absent resource and prove neither path silently selects unrelated brush content.

invalid_icc_reported_as_validation_error.evidence: The exact inspect_icc_profile handler appends the LittleCMS exception type to validation errors and leaves both valid and littlecms_valid false. tests/test_painter_color_management.py::test_icc_validation_reports_littlecms_rejection_as_typed_validation_error injects a malformed payload and proves the failure contract.

overlay_font_fallback_or_asset_failure_r.evidence: The five exact overlay handlers have end-to-end caller coverage. Named Windows font failures fall through to Pillow's default font and both subtitle and bubble output remain nonblank. Malformed sticker decode and injected PNG save OSError return explicit failure. render_sticker_to_png now preflights its source, and VideoExportThread aborts and cleans temporary files when any stroke, bubble, or sticker overlay renderer returns false instead of omitting artwork from a successful video. Parameterized tests cover all three exporter overlay kinds. Typography parity and malformed-asset recovery are not claimed.

invalid_optional_preview_color_uses_decl.evidence_required: Limit the fallback to non-artwork preview color, expose that fallback in the report, and reject invalid committed artwork colors.

invalid_optional_serialized_value_reject.evidence_required: Inject invalid color-window, path-point, and PBR-slider payloads; prove no committed artwork state changes, no fabricated geometry/value is reported as valid, and a product-visible diagnostic exists where a default is retained.

qt_or_opengl_capability_failure_uses_dec.evidence: The two exact PaintDialog handlers cover QPixmap alpha-capability probing and Painter GPU-capability reporting. A failed QPixmap wrapper query uses the equivalent QImage alpha query and records/clears background_alpha_probe operational state; a failed GPU capability call returns a disabled persistent-atlas contract with the QPainter renderer and records the typed error. tests/test_painter_m3_integration.py::test_qt_alpha_and_gpu_capability_failures_use_declared_fallbacks injects and recovers both paths, proves non-null display output, explicit fallback renderer, and exact type/message diagnostics.

filesystem_probe_or_asset_write_failure_.evidence_required: Inject path-stat, directory-create, and image-write failures; prove no asset path/reference is committed and the caller can distinguish failure from success.

invalid_optional_qt_event_rejected_witho.evidence_required: Inject malformed channel/layer list events and prove False is returned with selection, visibility, and document state unchanged; unexpected internal errors must propagate.

qt_coordinate_mapping_failure_uses_input.evidence_required: Inject a destroyed or incompatible Qt object mapping failure and prove the input point fallback is safe for the declared host relationship, with an exposed diagnostic if placement can be affected.

invalid_serialized_scalar_normalization_.evidence_required: Define the legacy serialized scalar domain and verify malformed values are reported or normalized without changing unrelated document state.

invalid_structural_identifier_defaults_t.evidence_required: Prove malformed identifiers remain stable and non-colliding, or reject them explicitly; a function name is not sufficient evidence.

opengl_unavailability_reported_in_status.evidence: The three exact cheap status handlers cover PyOpenGL import and canvas-capability probe failure without creating a context. Status separates dependency_ready and candidate_backend from actual active_backend, keeps available false and QPainter active until a real runtime owns a context, and includes typed import/capabilities errors. tests/test_painter_3d_blockout.py::test_painter_opengl_import_failure_is_typed_and_selects_cpu and ::test_canvas_status_survives_capability_probe_failure inject both boundaries and prove status remains callable and cannot claim active OpenGL.

optional_extension_callback_failure_isol.evidence: The eleven exact handlers isolate only optional paint, click, interaction, rectangle, color-window, or context-menu callbacks. DrawingCanvas records the originating type and full message in interaction_error, exposed through Painter Action operational_errors.canvas_interaction; PaintDialog records context-menu failure separately. Failed interaction callbacks reset active state and return before pen/default-widget fallthrough. Color-window edit failure preserves the prior payload, callback failure occurs only after the edited payload is committed, and callback failures do not change committed strokes. tests/test_painter_m3_integration.py::test_canvas_interaction_hook_failure_is_fail_closed_and_reported covers press/move and recovery; ::test_all_optional_canvas_callbacks_report_failure_without_mutating_strokes injects paint, click, double-click, rectangle release, interaction release, color edit/callback, and context-menu failures and proves the stroke list is unchanged. The double-click test caught and fixed a real fallthrough that previously allowed a second press callback to overwrite the primary failure. Extension callback availability is not claimed.

source_load_or_validation_failure_append.evidence: All five exact aggregate_product_reapproval decode handlers mark the named source loaded=false with exception type/message, append a source-specific aggregation error, and therefore force aggregation_valid and release_ready false. The five-case parameterized test tests/test_painter_product_reapproval.py::test_reapproval_source_decode_failures_are_typed_and_invalidate_aggregation injects JSONDecodeError into the required-source loop, independent agent, independent threshold agent, independent numeric agent, and soak-series paths.

structured_async_worker_failure_telemetr.evidence: The exact MaterialTileExecutor._finish handler records exception type/message, operation kind, tile coordinates, and revision in a deque bounded to 32 entries, increments failed, returns before completed is incremented, and is covered by tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_material_tile_executor_exposes_bounded_failure_causes.

structured_optional_feature_failure_tele.evidence: The nine exact optional-feature handlers cover Wet Canvas future completion, retained layer-view synchronization, reference color sampling, reference palette extraction, 3D blockout OpenGL preview, PBR material-cache upload, PBR texture preview, brush material-profile lookup, and recovery-writer observation. Failures preserve type and full message in the feature report, explicit fallback renderer status, bounded Painter operational_errors, or recovery detail; no failing path reports the optional stage as successful. Reference failures leave the document palette unchanged, blockout failure returns a non-null declared QPainter fallback, and the combined failure test preserves the layer list. tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_optional_painter_feature_failures_are_typed_and_preserve_document_state injects six boundaries, while ::test_canvas_runtime_sync_failure_is_exposed_and_success_clears_it, ::test_pbr_material_cache_failure_is_exposed_and_success_clears_it, and ::test_brush_material_profile_failure_is_exposed_and_success_clears_it cover the remaining three and successful clearing. Optional feature equivalence after fallback is not claimed.

transactional_export_primary_failure_and.evidence: The seven exact handlers cover directory generation, staged-file validation, directory commit, committed-stage cleanup, single-file generation/commit, installed-file removal, backup restoration, and failed-stage cleanup. Staging is created beside the destination and every file install/restore uses os.replace on that filesystem. tests/test_painter_export_transaction.py injects generation, validation, second-backup, second-install, installed-file-removal, backup-restore, created-directory-removal, committed-stage cleanup, and failed-stage cleanup failures. It proves unchanged prior files on generation failure, complete restoration including removal of a newly created empty destination when rollback succeeds, exact primary and rollback type/message diagnostics, and a preserved recovery staging path when rollback cannot complete. A cleanup failure after commit returns committed=true plus typed cleanup diagnostics rather than reporting the completed export as failed. Mapping-return PBR/document/PNG transaction paths remap staged report paths to final paths; brush-bundle export retains its existing Path return contract and is verified by destination content. Python documents successful same-filesystem os.replace as atomic. This contract does not claim a filesystem-wide atomic multi-file transaction, power-loss durability, or recovery after process termination.

user_visible_operation_failure_without_s.evidence: The twelve exact PaintDialog handlers cover custom-brush import/export, PNG export, image-layer import, document save/open, flat export, layered/baked PSD export, PSD import, and editor-object provider/render failures. tests/test_painter_user_operation_failures.py injects every handler and proves the exact exception type and full message are visible, no information-level success message is emitted, and existing layers, strokes, stickers, and brushes remain unchanged. tests/test_painter_export_transaction.py additionally proves existing PNG, document, brush-bundle, and PBR-map destinations are unchanged or restored across generation, backup, install, removal, restore, and cleanup failures. The PBR dialog test proves transaction failure is reported without a success claim. This contract does not claim recovery after process termination or external-application format parity.
